posts.topic: Israel CTC Threshold Drops to NIS 5,000
posts.hook: Israel's e-invoicing mandate reaches its final threshold by June 2026, two years ahead of schedule.
posts.key_stat: Allocation number now required on invoices above NIS 10,000 (Jan 2026), dropping to NIS 5,000 (Jun 2026).
posts.visual_direction: Clean stat card leading with NIS 5,000 and the two-date timeline, reinforcing the compressed compliance deadline for enterprise CFOs.
